title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 42: City life (Set 3)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm City life (Set 3) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm City life (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Complete the sentence by changing the form of the word in capitals. The city has buildings and famous sights that make it a great place to visit. (ATTRACT)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm City life (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Complete the conversation, using the following words. Anna: Hey, Tom! How was your morning today? Tom: It was terrible! I took a taxi. But because of the 12.1 , I got stuck in a huge 12.2 for almost an hour. I couldn't move at all. Anna: That sounds frustrating. So how did you manage to get to work? Tom: I had to get out of the car and walk on the 12.3 . It was much faster, but still not great. And I got soaked when I arrived. Anna: Oh no! It must be uncomfortable. Tom: Yeah, it was pretty bad. But at least I can grab something to eat at the 12.4 now to feel better. Anna: That sounds like a good idea! Hopefully, a warm meal will help you relax.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm City life (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Complete the text, using the words given. You may make any changes to the words if necessary. There are two words/phrases that you don't need to use. high crime rate city authority carry out throw away chairman immigrant In many cities, life can be difficult for 14.1 who are trying to settle in a new country. They often face challenges in finding a job and adjusting to a new environment. Some areas of the city are known for having a(n) 14.2 , which makes people feel unsafe. This can be especially worrying for those who are still unfamiliar with their new surroundings. The 14.3 plays a crucial role in addressing these problems. They must ensure that every citizen has the support they need and that safety is a top priority. To improve the situation, they must 14.4 programs to reduce crime and help newcomers integrate better into the community. By focusing on these issues, the city can become a safer and more welcoming place for everyone.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài City life (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Read the following announcement and choose the option that best fits each blank. Important Notice for All Residents Due to ongoing construction work in the city, there will be significant changes. Here’s what you need to know: Traffic 15.1 session feature flow sample  will be affected, leading to possible delays, especially during rush hours. Please follow all road signs and instructions carefully to ensure traffic 15.2 advantage safety condition hygiene . Residents near the construction sites should be prepared for loud sounds leading to 15.3 light noise air water  pollution. For a(n) 15.4 classical ancient peaceful international  environment, we recommend using quieter routes near the suburbs to avoid the construction zones. We appreciate your patience as we work to improve the city. Thank you for your understanding!

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm City life (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Read the conversation and then choose the correct answer to fill in each blank. Alice: I saw a report about food 13.1 waste emission in our city. It is a serious issue. Jack: That is true. Many restaurants 13.2 throw give away too much food every day. Alice: That’s not good for the environment. How can we deal with 13.3 amenities leftovers ? Jack: I think we can 13.4 process remove them into compost for farming. Alice: That’s a good solution. We can also use some of the make energy like biogas. Jack: Exactly! It would benefit both the environment and the city.
